weight_derivation.method: GSO links baseline + Royal Birkdale hazard adjustments

adjustments_applied.rationale: Royal Birkdale gorse corridors and coastal rough impose severe penalties on inaccuracy off the tee; drives outside tight target zones face unplayable lies or forced layups
General positional play less differentiated when accuracy constraints dominate; Birkdale rewards specific fairway zones over broad tee-shot excellence
Balance adjustment to maintain weight sum = 1.00; overall approach play slightly less separated than approach precision from 150-200 yards

notes: Trait columns map to GSO field input matrix columns; rebuild trait_form_matrix from 2026 Open field when data becomes available
ott_accuracy weight (0.16) is the highest accuracy premium in the VenueDNA library — only Carnoustie exceeds it
sg_putt weight intentionally held at GSO level; Birkdale greens are challenging but not the decisive differentiator vs links accuracy
